messages:
Maria (Marketing): Hey team — draft Concordi case study is up for quote selection and legal check. Target publish: Mon 2026-06-01. Need final quote + signed release by EOD Fri.
Kevin (Producer): Uploaded raw call recording + transcript to the assets folder. Link: https://redwood.app/assets/concordi/raw-call-05-27
AssetsBot: Transcript processed: /assets/concordi/transcripts/3232109876-concordi-call.vtt
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): We can provide a short CTO quote. Prefer to keep revenue numbers high-level ("double-digit %") not exact $ amounts.
Maria (Marketing): Good call — we'll pick a concise soundbite. @Derek can you share a one-liner by Thu? Example we like: "Redwood made our inference pipeline 3x cheaper" — feel free to reword.
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): Draft: "Redwood cut our inference unit cost by over 60% while improving SLA stability." — ok to use? cc @Sara (Legal)
Sara (Legal): Quick flags: "cut" language may imply liability if not accurate. Recommend "reduced" and avoid specific %s unless Concordi signs off in writing. Also need customer's signed release + logo usage agreement.
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): OK — change to: "Redwood reduced our inference unit cost by over 60% while improving SLA stability." I'll route the release to our legal and send signed copy by Thu EOD.
Matt (Sales): Heads-up — please route any inbound demo requests from this case (Concordi) to the East Coast AE queue (team_concordi_leads@redwood). We want to trigger personalized outreach in the first 48 hrs.
Maria (Marketing): Noted. @AssetsBot can you add a campaign tag and webhook to route new leads from the case page?
AssetsBot: Webhook created: POST https://hooks.redwood.ai/leads?campaign=concordi-case -> team_concordi_leads@redwood
Kevin (Producer): For the launch assets: we need a 30s quote clip, a 2-paragraph case post, a 1-slide benchmark snapshot showing p50 latency + cost per 1k tokens. Can we get clips from the raw recording by Fri?
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): I'll pull a 30s clip and mark preferred quote timestamps in the transcript.
Maria (Marketing): Legal signoff required before publish. @Sara can you confirm by Fri noon? If any redlines, we'll push publish to next week.
Sara (Legal): Confirmed — will review release + quote by Fri noon. If Concordi signs release and accepts revised wording, we can approve.
Kevin (Producer): Also planning a short webinar follow-up (30 min) with Concordi + our infra PM. Proposed date: Tue 2026-06-09 10am PT. @Matt can you confirm AE availability to staff booth/triage leads?
Matt (Sales): I can cover triage. Put me down as primary contact for lead follow-up during webinar.
Maria (Marketing): Great — I'll draft the webinar registration copy and a 1-paragraph benchmark summary for posting. @Derek please confirm Concordi will join panel or prefer pre-recorded.
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): We'll join live if our CTO schedule clears; otherwise pre-recorded ok.
Maria (Marketing): Action items summary:
• Derek: provide approved quote + signed release by Thu EOD
• Sara: legal review + signoff by Fri noon
• Kevin: extract 30s clip + slide mock by Fri
• AssetsBot: set campaign tag + lead webhook
• Matt: AE triage for webinar and lead routing
We'll reconvene Fri 11am for final go/no-go. :calendar:
Kevin (Producer): Added a draft timeline in the shared doc: https://redwood.app/docs/concordi-case/timeline
Derek (Customer Success - Concordi): Thanks everyone — will prioritize the release paperwork.
Maria (Marketing): Thanks — appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
